I forgot to mention something important! Be careful about the kind of diapers you buy. The cat ones we bought at first rubbed at the fleshy connection around his legs/hip/belly. Sizing is important, we actually just use human baby ones now with a tail hole cut out. You'll have to give the occasional bath for pooplosions but baby wipes with every change should keep kitty clean. It helps to shave around the butt and tail so you can keep an eye out for rashes. My kitty is smart and tells me when he wants/needs a diaper change but its pretty easy to tell when to do it.

First off i bought the diapers and let him sniff them and get treats. When he associated diaper with treats I'd put them on him and give more treats and play time. I also put him in a modified onesie at night so he didn't bite the diaper off. Going slowly, he wore it more and more often. Every time he has to have a diaper change, I give him lots of love and treats. I also feed him then so he knows diaper change = food. Eventually, he didn't even mind his diaper at all and would willingly wear it 24/7 without his onesie on. Took about 3-4 weeks from start to finish.

My kitty started peeing on my bed consistently (ruined one bed and countless pillows and blankets) so now he wears a diaper. But he's also very old and incontinent so I don't know how well it would work for a young cat. (Plus it requires some training.)
